column1: # Scala: traits (listed as interfaces), classes, case classes, enums (listed as
# classes), objects (listed as variables: a singleton value, so a companion
# does not compete with its class), and defs (listed as functions: a member is
# a function whose qualified name carries its type). An enum case is listed as
# a function, the catch-all kind for a kind the query does not name. A call, a
# `new` and an import are not definitions. A type alias (also an abstract type
# member) is a type_alias, and an operator def (`def /`) a function. A def local
# to a block, and a def of an anonymous class, are not definitions.
